name: Call of Water
summary: Call of Water is an initiation rite that directs rising Horde shaman from the heights of Thunder Bluff toward the eastern shores of the Barrens. To commune with the cleansing element of water, an initiate must seek out the recluse Islen Waterseer. This meeting marks the first step on a spiritual journey to earn the Water Totem.

sections.title: A Summons from the Bluff
sections.body: Having mastered the unyielding earth and the untamed flame, an aspiring shaman is eventually deemed ready to study the deeper mysteries of the elements. In Thunder Bluff, trainers like Xanis Flameweaver recognize when a student has shown enough discipline to approach the fluid, cleansing spirit of water. The journey requires leaving the windswept mesas of Mulgore behind and traveling east across the sun-scorched plains of the Barrens.

sections.title: The Hermit of the Coast
sections.body: The path leads to Islen Waterseer, a quiet mystic who lives away from the bustling settlements, residing in a humble fishing shack on the eastern coast south of Ratchet and the mouth of the Southfury River. Standing at the edge of the great ocean, Islen reads the readiness of travelers by how the elements linger about them. Seeing the steady earth, the brisk wind, and the warmth of fire already bound to the seeker's spirit, she prepares them for the trials required to understand water's purity.

faq.q: Who sends me on this journey?
aliases: where to get call of water tb
faq.answer: Shaman trainers in Thunder Bluff, such as Xanis Flameweaver, bestow this quest once an initiate has advanced far enough in their spiritual training to pursue the rites of water.
Islen Waterseer lives in a lonely fishing hut on the eastern coast of the Barrens. Her dwelling sits along the shore south of Ratchet and south of where the Southfury River meets the sea.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Call of Water trial?
faq.answer: The trial is an essential rite of passage for every shaman seeking communion with water. It tests the initiate's understanding of elemental purity and leads directly to earning their Water Totem.

faq.q: Do other Horde races receive this same instruction?
faq.answer: While the introductory summons in Thunder Bluff is typically taken by tauren, orc and troll shaman in Orgrimmar and Sen'jin receive similar calls to seek out Islen Waterseer on the Barrens coast.

faq.q: What elements must a shaman master before water?
faq.answer: A shaman communes with the steady earth and the destructive yet life-giving fire before seeking the fluid nature of water. As Islen notes upon your arrival, earth, wind, and fire must already touch your spirit before water will reveal its purity.

faq.q: What happens after finding Islen Waterseer?
faq.answer: Speaking with Islen concludes the initial journey from Thunder Bluff. She will immediately challenge you with further tasks across Kalimdor to understand and purify the element of water directly.

angles.text: This rite marks the transition from early elemental trials toward mastering the fluid powers of cleansing, restoration, and tide.
Starting in Thunder Bluff, this task carries young shu'halo shaman out from Mulgore's sheltered plains into the wider expanse of Kalimdor.
Shamanism remains a bedrock of the new Horde, linking ancient traditions across orc, troll, and tauren spiritualists.
